intent: Provide invoice and business reason to buyer for initial review and processing.
payload_summary: Invoice and business reason sent to buyer.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present
expected_effect: Buyer receives invoice and business reason to proceed with processing under normal workflow.

intent: To inquire about the current status of the payment or processing.
payload_summary: Requesting an update on payment processing status to understand next steps.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present
Requester has sent invoice and business reason to buyer
expected_effect: Receive an update on payment or processing status to inform vendor planning.

intent: To obtain explicit approval from the approver before proceeding with payment.
payload_summary: Requesting explicit approval for payment given invoice and business reason but no prior explicit approval.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present
expected_effect: Approver will either approve or reject the payment before buyer proceeds.

intent: Record explicit approval for payment based on presence of invoice and business reason with no contradicting evidence.
payload_summary: Approve payment as invoice and business reason are present and no negative evidence exists.
preconditions_claimed: No explicit rejection or conflicting evidence
expected_effect: Payment approval status is recorded explicitly, enabling buyer to proceed with accounting handoff and payment processing.

intent: Hand off the payment request to accounting with explicit approval evidence included
payload_summary: Submitting payment request with invoice and business reason confirmed, including explicit approval from approver.
expected_effect: Accounting receives a payment request fully backed by explicit approval, enabling payment processing to proceed.

intent: Advance payment since explicit approval is confirmed and all required evidence is present.
payload_summary: Prepare payment for invoice with explicit approver approval and valid business reason as handed off by buyer.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present
Explicit approval from approver is present in buyer handoff
No negative evidence or ambiguity in approval exists
expected_effect: Payment preparation proceeds correctly with full compliance to policy and evidence supporting approval.
